sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare and Energy dominate leadership with sustained cross-timeframe strength, while Consumer Defensive shows early signs of fading despite an all-green profile.

Leadership remains narrow as only 3 of 11 sectors post all-green returns across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons. Healthcare and Energy represent the core pillars of strength, maintaining top-3 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month frames with high momentum scores of 0.883 and 0.850, respectively. 

Meanwhile, rotation is muted across the broader market. Technology holds steady in rank 2 with a 0.633 momentum score, but defensives show fractures: Consumer Defensive slipped 1 spot over the last five sessions despite its all-green status. Communication Services (0.217 momentum) and Utilities (0.167 momentum) continue to anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Healthcare (0.88 momentum), Energy (0.85 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.65 momentum) are the only 3 of 11 sectors positive across all measured windows (week, month, quarter, half, YTD).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Healthcare and Energy are the sole sectors maintaining top-3 standing across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks, sitting at YTD ranks of 3 and 1, respectively.
- **Top Momentum Tier:** Healthcare (0.883) and Energy (0.850) lead all groups, followed by Consumer Defensive (0.650) and Technology (0.633).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rank Advancers:** Healthcare rose +1 spot over the past 5 sessions to reach rank 3, while Real Estate climbed +1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.267).
- **Rank Decliners:** Consumer Defensive dropped -1 spot to rank 4, and Communication Services fell -1 spot to rank 9 (momentum 0.217).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Utilities sits at the bottom of momentum rankings with a score of 0.167 (YTD rank 10), closely trailed by Communication Services (0.217) and Real Estate (0.267).

## Divergences
- **Consumer Defensive Fading:** Consumer Defensive exhibits a key early-warning divergence, carrying elevated momentum (0.650) and an all-green backdrop, yet shedding 1 rank spot over the last 5 sessions.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Travel-related real estate, healthcare, and traditional energy are leading broad market strength, while industrial and agricultural segments suffer sharp multi-day pullbacks.

Market breadth shows 29 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. High momentum remains concentrated in hospitality and healthcare, led by REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.921 momentum) and Health Information Services (0.885 momentum). Meanwhile, sustained multi-month leadership persists across oil and gas segments alongside medical distribution and reinsurance.

Rotation is actively penalizing construction, commodities, and digital media. Engineering & Construction plunged 24 spots over the last five sessions, accompanied by steep declines in Coking Coal and Internet Content & Information. Conversely, early signs of bottoming are emerging in housing-adjacent groups like Residential Construction and Building Materials, which are climbing the ranks despite depressed momentum profiles.

## Strength
- **Travel and Real Estate:** REIT - Hotel & Motel posts the market's highest momentum score (0.921, rank 7 YTD), closely tracked by Lodging (0.883 momentum, rank 29).
- **Healthcare & Energy Resilience:** Health Information Services (0.885 momentum) and Diagnostics & Research (0.868 momentum) maintain all-green profiles and sustained top-36 positioning over 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows alongside Oil & Gas Integrated (0.86 momentum) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.84 momentum).
- **Deep Laggards:** Weakness remains entrenched in REIT - Mortgage (0.072 momentum, rank 136 YTD), Solar (0.078 momentum, rank 139 YTD), and Advertising Agencies (0.110 momentum, rank 144 YTD).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Insurance Brokers led rank improvement (+17 spots to rank 103, momentum 0.63), matching Lodging (+17 spots to rank 29), with Silver also jumping (+15 spots to rank 45, momentum 0.59).
- **Sharp De-escalations:** Engineering & Construction fell 24 spots to rank 62 (0.23 momentum), Coking Coal dropped 19 spots to rank 117 (0.23 momentum), and Internet Content & Information dropped 17 spots to rank 74 (0.46 momentum).
- **Agricultural Weakness:** Farm Products slid 15 spots to rank 46 (0.35 momentum) while Agricultural Inputs shed 13 spots to fall to rank 61 (0.32 momentum).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Software - Infrastructure (0.63 momentum, rank -8) and Shell Companies (0.70 momentum, rank -6) are losing rank rapidly despite elevated momentum scores, alongside Tobacco (0.63 momentum, rank -7).
- **Early-Stage Turnarounds:** Residential Construction gained 5 spots in 5 sessions despite weak 0.29 momentum, while Building Materials rose 4 spots (0.32 momentum) and Integrated Freight & Logistics advanced 5 spots (0.47 momentum).
